title: Reflection Halaqah Night
desc:
As salamu alaykum sisters, we pray that you’re all doing well insha’Allah 🫶🏽

Join us this Saturday at Masjid Khalid bin Al Walid at 5:30 pm as we open our hearts to reflect on our lives and purpose as Muslim sisters together lead by our Sister Lulay.

Don’t forget to tell a friend to tell a friend 🤍
